changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant output descriptions into a single clear description. All extracted metadata was correct and relevant to the NLG task (sign language to text translation).

Simplified metric variants to base forms as per guidelines. Recall at different ranks consolidated to 'Recall'. P-I and P-C (per-instance and per-class accuracy) normalized to 'Top-1 Accuracy'. Added 'Top-1 Accuracy' category.
Removed placeholder 'None' values as the paper does not use LLMs as judges. All fields properly set to empty arrays.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on sign language processing with SHuBERT as a video representation model and ByT5 as the text generation component. The NLG task is sign language translation to English text. Evaluation uses standard automatic metrics (BLEU, BLEURT) but no human or LLM-based evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric variants.
